purpose: base network input for the Porto Alegre reproduction pipeline

columns.node1/node2: segment key, unique, carried through unchanged
columns.speed: km/h; cost = dist / (speed/60), i.e. metre-equivalents at 60 km/h
columns.area: static weight R (buildable area, 30 m buffer); 0 = routes but not a zone

model_reconstruction.graph: split every segment at its midpoint; endpoints and midpoints are nodes

verification.note: result columns are deliberately absent here; scored against the submitted columns by data/frozen/network/reconstruct_paper_run.py
